topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I can hardly believe what I'm holding in my hands. It looks like a time capsule, old and worn, just unearthed from where it had been hidden. The markings on it are faint, almost faded away, but they don’t match anything I remember making. How did it end up in my backyard, buried so carefully? I’ve been going through everything inside, trying to find a clue, anything that makes sense. Photos, letters, trinkets—none of them mean anything to me. I’m scouring the internet, asking old neighbors if they remember anything. It’s like a puzzle, and I need to solve it. I can’t just let it go. There’s something in these old, forgotten items that’s calling to me, a story I need to uncover.
